_comment: Decision Doctor monorepo: the Railway service `decision-doctor-workers` builds and runs ONLY the workers/ subdirectory. The Next.js web app at root deploys to Vercel separately and is NOT a Railway target. After Railway's Nixpacks→Railpack migration, the previous workers/railway.json config stopped being honored — Railpack autodetects Next.js at root and tries to build it, which fails because the workers service does not have BETTER_AUTH_SECRET/RESEND_API_KEY/etc. (those are Vercel env). This file overrides install/build/start to be workers-only.

commands: echo 'workers service — no build step; tsx loads TS at runtime (Atomize-verified pattern)'
